purpose: Portable handoff for a future managed driver covering expert bootstrap, evaluation, self-play, and eventual Elmo+Bert+Inzi utilization.

model_plan.operational_reference: immutable r195 in its native configuration
model_plan.new_path: additive structured public-rule residual plus repaired auxiliary heads

requirements: source/day/group-disjoint train, validation, and evaluation manifests

managed_stages.name: schema_and_zero_bypass_freeze
managed_stages.work: Validate structured catalog provenance, schemas, information-set metamorphic tests, and bit-identical layer-off behavior.
managed_stages.exit_gate: All schema identities and zero-bypass receipts pass; unsupported branches remain exact-zero.

managed_stages.name: thirty_day_refeaturization_and_census
managed_stages.work: Validate, deduplicate, and re-featurize all 30 partitions while producing coverage and collision census outputs.
managed_stages.parallel_safe_work: As each immutable shard reaches at most 96 MiB and passes SHA/schema/size checks, stage it create-only to the authorized quarantined Inzi directory using at most four lanes.
managed_stages.exit_gate: Complete raw-manifest, census, shard, resource-peak, and source/remote parity receipts.

managed_stages.name: frozen_backbone_expert_bootstrap
managed_stages.work: Train only the new structured adapter, repaired auxiliary heads, and census-supported eligible gates.
managed_stages.warm_start: Reuse compatible existing-head tensors or predictions where shape and semantics match exactly; record every mapping and leave unmatched outputs neutral.
managed_stages.exit_gate: Held-out source/day/group-disjoint metrics improve without hidden-information leakage, severe rule regression, or baseline-off parity failure.

managed_stages.name: pre_self_play_paired_evaluation
managed_stages.work: Run receipt-bound seed-matched, seat-swapped comparisons against unchanged r241/r274 and immutable r195; keep the r195-new-list comparison explicitly labeled as a deck-shift confound.
managed_stages.exit_gate: No severe rule-error regression; acceptable action-disagreement and checklist-channel evidence; candidate receipt complete.

managed_stages.name: short_frozen_backbone_self_play
managed_stages.work: Run 1 to 3 managed self-play iterations with the backbone and existing learned paths still frozen. Train the new path at a low learning rate and retain rollback checkpoints per iteration.
managed_stages.exit_gate: Paired evaluation improves game outcome without increased deck-outs, severe mechanics errors, prize-race regressions, or unstable residual magnitude.

managed_stages.name: optional_limited_unfreeze
managed_stages.work: Only after explicit owner approval, consider unfreezing a narrowly selected late policy/fusion component; never default to full-model RL.
managed_stages.exit_gate: A new receipt-backed owner decision names the exact tensors, learning rates, rollback point, and evaluation gate.

hardware_topology.eventual_target: Use Elmo, Bert, and Inzi concurrently under one receipt-backed managed scheduler.

current_authority.Elmo: May perform isolated implementation validation, corpus work, training, and evaluation under the canonical experiment contract.
current_authority.Inzi: May only receive validated create-only shards in the quarantined staging directory; it may not load, train, evaluate, or execute them under the current contract.
current_authority.Bert: No compute authority is granted by the current experiment contract.

Elmo: GPU training and candidate checkpoint production
Inzi: future training only after a separate explicit production-goal authorization

hardware_topology.promotion_requirement: Before Bert or Inzi executes experiment bytes, the authoritative goal must be revised explicitly and a scheduler receipt must bind host roles, package/checkpoint/schema hashes, seeds, resource limits, and rollback behavior.

wall_time_and_transfer_policy.reason: Overlap safe transfer with continuing Elmo materialization and avoid redundant copies through immutable content addressing.

required_comparisons: candidate vs unchanged r241/r274 on the exact same new list
candidate vs immutable r195 in r195 native operational configuration
exploratory r195 weights with new list, labeled deck-shift confound
required_metrics: residual responsible for each changed action

stop_and_rollback_conditions: hidden or privileged information changes a pre-transition policy result
layer-off logits or legal choices differ from the frozen baseline
non-finite loss, logits, residuals, or parameters
validation worsens for the configured patience interval
resource ceiling or scheduler role boundary is exceeded
artifact, checkpoint, schema, seed, or host-role receipt mismatch

activation.next_action_for_main_driver: Adopt this proposal into the authoritative managed-system goal through an explicit owner revision before scheduling Bert/Inzi compute.
